findings.title: CRLF guide files are incorrectly rejected for adoption
findings.description: Description: Adoption validation relies on `ContextProfileParser.parseProfiles` to recognize the `brownfield-adoption` profile. That parser searches for the literal `context_profiles:\n` (`packages/core/src/services/ContextProfileParser.ts:10, 134`), so a valid guide checked out with CRLF line endings is not recognized. On such checkouts, a brownfield build throws an `AdoptionError` claiming the profile is missing instead of generating the prompt. Normalize line endings or make profile detection tolerate them, and cover this case with a test.

findings.title: An obsolete test copy is not included in the test suite
findings.description: Description: This added file duplicates the older `CoreServiceFactory` tests and still calls `createContextPipeline` without the now-required options. It is excluded by `packages/core/vitest.config.ts` and the core TypeScript config, so it is neither run nor typechecked. Remove the stale copy to avoid maintaining misleading, unverified tests.
